Messages.Author: ShunnedOne
Messages.Body:
hi. this situation came up in JOL:

seterpenre does a d action at +1 stealth
khalil wakes and blocks with +1 intercept from KRCG
seterpenre plays faceless night
khalil plays pseudo-blindness cancelling it
seterpenre plays lost in crowds
joaquina wakes and attempts to play pseudo-blindness too.

can she?

what if she "attempts to block" (failing because she doesn't have the
intercept)? can she then play pseudo-blindness and khalil can still try to
block?

thanks!

neil

-----------------
card text:

Pseudo-Blindness [FN:C2, LotN:PR2]

Cardtype: Reaction

Cost: 1 blood

Discipline: Chimerstry

[chi] Only usable by a vampire attempting to block. Cancel an action
modifier that requires Chimerstry [chi] or Obfuscate [obf] as it is played.

[CHI] As above, and if this vampire successfully blocks this action, the
acting minion cannot use cards that require Chimerstry or Obfuscate during
the resulting combat.

Messages.Author: Robert Scythe
Messages.Body:
On Dec 17, 8:54 pm, "ShunnedOne" <shun...@one.com> wrote:
> hi. this situation came up in JOL:
>
> seterpenre does a d action at +1 stealth
> khalil wakes and blocks with +1 intercept from KRCG
> seterpenre plays faceless night
> khalil plays pseudo-blindness cancelling it
> seterpenre plays lost in crowds
> joaquina wakes and attempts to play pseudo-blindness too.
>
> can she?

Well, you can use a Wake affect and then use a card that would cancel
a card as it is played, but there is no precedent for whether you can
attempt to block in between that, that I know of (though I do not see
a problem with it).

> what if she "attempts to block" (failing because she doesn't have the
> intercept)? can she then play pseudo-blindness and khalil can still try to
> block?

If she can attempt to block and then play Psuedo-Blindness then yes,
after failing, Khalil can re-attempt to block.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
ShunnedOne wrote:
> hi. this situation came up in JOL:
>
> seterpenre does a d action at +1 stealth
> khalil wakes and blocks with +1 intercept from KRCG
> seterpenre plays faceless night
> khalil plays pseudo-blindness cancelling it
> seterpenre plays lost in crowds
> joaquina wakes and attempts to play pseudo-blindness too.
>
> can she?

No. Khalil is attempting to block, not Joaquina.

> what if she "attempts to block" (failing because she doesn't have the
> intercept)? can she then play pseudo-blindness and khalil can still try to
> block?

After Khalil's block attempt fails, Joaquina could make an attempt, sure. During
that attempt, if Seterpenre plays a suitable card, Joaquina could cancel it with
Psuedo-Blindness. And then, if Joaquina's block attempt fails, Khalil could make
another attempt, sure.


